# Wavelength — The Mind-Reading Party Game

> Wavelength is a free browser party game: one player hides a target on a spectrum between two opposing concepts and the team moves a needle to find it.

Canonical: https://furkankoykiran.com.tr/wavelength/
Source: https://github.com/furkankoykiran/wavelength
Languages: en, tr, es, zh, hi, pt, bn, ru, ja, vi
License: MIT

## What it is

Wavelength is a digital adaptation of the spectrum-guessing party game. Each round shows two
opposite concepts at the ends of a line — for example "hot" and "cold", or "cheap" and "expensive".
One player sees where the target sits on that spectrum and gives a clue. The rest of the team moves
the needle to where they think the target is, and the round scores by how close they land.

## How to play

1. Open https://furkankoykiran.com.tr/wavelength/.
2. Choose the number of teams (1–8) and start the game.
3. The active player reads the hidden target position and gives a clue.
4. The team moves the needle and locks in a guess.
5. Repeat until the scoreboard picks a winner.

## Features

- Hidden target on a two-concept spectrum with distance-based scoring
- 1 to 8 teams, including a solo mode
- Ten interface languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, Portuguese, Bengali, Russian, Japanese and Vietnamese
- Light and dark themes
- No account, no tracking and no backend
